description: Validate a selected Pro or Platinum price and generate an environment-appropriate Nas.com checkout link for either an existing community or a new onboarding session. This does not start payment or create a subscription.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

planType.description: Plan the user chose; use one of the allowed values.

priceId.description: Plan price ID returned unchanged by get_onboarding_plan_options or the plan price tools.

name: generate_plan_checkout_link
title: Generate Plan Checkout Link
